questions.original_stem: What is the next number in the sequence: 4, 12, 20, 28, 36, ___ ?

hint.level_0: A pattern has a rule. Find the rule first, then use it to predict the next term.
hint.level_1: Look at how each number or item changes to get the next one. Write down the differences between consecutive terms. The difference between each pair is 8. So the next number is 28 + 8 = 36.
hint.level_2: Here's the solution: Following the pattern rule gives us 44. Each step follows the same rule to get the next number.

questions.visual_context: The pattern elements shown in a row with the missing position highlighted.
solution_steps: Look at the differences: 12-4=8
The pattern adds 8 each time
Add 8 to the last number to find next
